threatLadder.name: Ember Watch
threatLadder.text: War-engines on the horizon. The late war begins.

threatLadder.name: Storm Siege
threatLadder.text: The siege comes in earnest — rams at the gates, fire from afar.

threatLadder.name: Eclipse
threatLadder.text: The sky goes dark at noon. Everything they have, all at once.

bosses.name: Gorm the Cinder-Maul
bosses.title: Siege-lord of the Cinder Clan
bosses.herald: 🔥 The ground shakes — GORM THE CINDER-MAUL marches with wave {wave}! Rams and ruin follow him. {seconds} breaths to bar every gate!
bosses.attack: Gorm the Cinder-Maul has come! Hold the walls — kill the siege-lord!
bosses.victory: The Cinder-Maul lies broken before the gates! The manner stands — +{loot} gold in war salvage.
bosses.lore: The Cinder Clan forged one engine they could not control, so they crowned it instead.

bosses.name: The Pale Queen
bosses.title: Voice of the Pale Court
bosses.herald: 🌙 A white banner on the treeline — THE PALE QUEEN herself rides with wave {wave}! Her court never misses. {seconds} breaths — to arms!
bosses.attack: The Pale Queen takes the field! Cut through her court — bring her down!
bosses.victory: The Pale Queen has withdrawn into the mist! Her court's gold is yours — +{loot} gold.
bosses.lore: The Pale Host was never an army. It was a court — and every court has a queen.
